$comment: One entry per skill catalog. scripts/gen-skills-catalog.mjs (frontmatter, packaging) and scripts/check-skill-contracts.mjs (verbs, cross-catalog names, protocol copies) iterate every entry, each with its own prefix and verb regex.

outputs names the build outputs a catalog feeds. null means the catalog is kept out of that output on purpose: the ow- catalog is in no dev plugin, zip, docs tree, flag registry, hosted MCP catalog or public mirror until a PR of its own wires it in.

The scripts that write those outputs (sync-plugin-skills, sync-skill-bundles, make-skills-zip, sync-docs, gen-mcp-catalog) refuse a source tree holding any skill outside the oc- prefix, so pointing OPCHAIN_SKILLS_DIR at skills-work/ fails before anything is deleted or written.

edges names the per-skill edges file (ow- contract R15). planned lists family skills not built yet; plannedVerbs declares the verbs a NEXT block may already name for one of them (ow-documentation's NEXT names /ow-care-request after the rollout closes, OW-05; ow-handoff's close NEXT names /ow-care-start for care-start.md and its after-close NEXT /ow-care-request, OW-06). ow-handoff left planned in OW-06 (1.0.0): its edges file now holds every sibling's reads of it to reciprocity. bodyTokenBudgets caps one skill's body below the catalog's bodyTokenBudget. ow-care is planned because ow-start's /ow-start-log indexes its files (an index: true reads row, owner decision O1 of OW-08). statusNames names what a verb's STATUS lines must carry (every `next: … | awaiting: …` template in its phase file). Both resolve names only: reciprocity is checked once the planned skill has its own edges file.

ow-research (OW-09, owner decision O9): ow-draft, ow-vendor-eval, ow-currency and ow-controls are planned, and /ow-draft-evidence and /ow-vendor-eval-evidence are declared now, because ow-research's answered NEXT blocks name them (their approved designs fix the verbs and the fields they read). ow-currency and ow-controls moved to v2.2 (owner decision 2026-10-19): /ow-currency-watch stays declared for the hand-off that returns with ow-currency, though no ow-research screen names it in 2.1; ow-controls is named by ow-research's licensed-text refusal as not in this release.
